component.name: ProbeScene
component.script:
sub init() m.ps = m.top.findNode("ps") m.menu = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ListPanel") m.menu.id = "menu" m.menu.panelSize = "narrow" m.menu.focusable = true m.menuList = CreateObject("roSGNode", "LabelList") m.menuList.id = "menuList" m.menuList.itemSize = [300, 60] c = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") for i = 0 to 2 c.createChild("ContentNode").title = "menu " + i.toStr() end for m.menuList.content = c m.menu.appendChild(m.menuList) m.menu.list = m.menuList m.menu.createNextPanelOnItemFocus = true m.menu.observeField("createNextPanelIndex", "onCreateNext") m.menuList.observeField("itemFocused", "onMenuItem") m.details = invalid m.lastState = "" m.nodes = [m.top, m.ps, m.menu, m.menuList] for each n in m.nodes n.observeField("focusedChild", "onFc") end for m.ps.appendChild(m.menu) m.menu.setFocus(true) m.poll = m.top.findNode("poll") m.poll.observeField("fire", "onPoll") m.poll.control = "start" m.ready = m.top.findNode("ready") m.ready.observeField("fire", "onReady") m.ready.control = "start" end sub
sub onCase() plog("boot", "case=" + m.top.probeCase) end sub
function nid(n as dynamic) as string if n = invalid then return "invalid" if n.isSameNode(m.top) then return "scene" if n.id = "" then return n.subtype() return n.id end function
function desc(n as object) as string f = "-" if n.hasFocus() f = "F" else if n.isInFocusChain() f = "c" end if return nid(n) + "[" + f + "]=" + nid(n.focusedChild) end function
sub onFc(ev as object) n = ev.getRoSGNode() plog("fc", desc(n)) end sub
sub onMenuItem() plog("item", "menuList itemFocused=" + m.menuList.itemFocused.toStr()) end sub
sub onInnerItem() plog("item", "inner itemFocused=" + m.inner.itemFocused.toStr()) end sub
sub onCreateNext() plog("act", "createNextPanelIndex=" + m.menu.createNextPanelIndex.toStr()) if m.details = invalid m.details = CreateObject("roSGNode", "DetailPanel") m.details.id = "details" m.details.probeCase = m.top.probeCase m.details.menuRef = m.menu m.details.observeField("backPressed", "onBack") m.wrap = m.details.findNode("wrap") m.inner = m.details.findNode("inner") m.inner.observeField("itemFocused", "onInnerItem") for each n in [m.details, m.wrap, m.inner] n.observeField("focusedChild", "onFc") m.nodes.push(n) end for end if m.menu.nextPanel = m.details end sub
sub onBack() plog("act", "backPressed: details.setFocus(false), menu.setFocus(true)") m.details.setFocus(false) r = m.menu.setFocus(true) plog("act", "menu.setFocus returned " + r.toStr()) end sub
sub onPoll() s = "" for each n in m.nodes s = s + " " + desc(n) end for if s <> m.lastState m.lastState = s plog("state", s.trim()) end if end sub
sub onReady() plog("ready", "|MANUAL|") end sub
